# Choose the plan that’s right for you

No credit card required

## Free

For simple projects and getting to know Gamma

---

[Start for free](/signup)

Free includes:

* 400 credits at signup
* Create up to 10 slides per prompt
* Simple presentations, docs, websites, social, and images
* Import from PDF & PPTX
* Export to PDF, PPTX, PNG & Google Slides

blah

## Plus

For extra AI power and removing Gamma branding

---

[Get started](/signup)

Everything in Free, and:

* 1,500 monthly credits
* Create up to 100 slides per prompt
* Remove Gamma branding
* Advanced AI image models

Most popular

## Pro

For premium AI models and more customization

---

[Get started](/signup)

Everything in Plus, and:

* 4,000 monthly credits
* Premium AI image models
* Custom branding
* Detailed analytics & advanced sharing
* Publish up to 10 custom domains

blah

## Ultra

For 20× more AI usage and unlocking access to the most advanced models

---

[Get started](/signup)

Everything in Pro, and:

* 20,000 monthly credits
* Access to the most advanced AI models (text, image, video)
* Publish up to 100 custom domains
* Early access to new features

Prices are subject to tax depending on your location.

We're a **SOC 2 Type II** compliant organization.

Learn more at our [Trust Center](https://trust.gamma.app)

## Frequently asked questions

We leverage a variety of the most advanced AI models to provide you with the best possible experience. These include:

* Claude (Anthropic)
* ChatGPT + DALL-E (OpenAI)
* Gemini (Google)
* Flux
* Recraft
* Playground
* Ideogram
* Luma
* Leonardo

This combination allows us to offer powerful capabilities in text generation, image creation, and design assistance while ensuring your data privacy and security.

Credits are used for AI features throughout Gamma. The number of credits an action uses can vary based on what you're doing, which AI model is used, and the length or complexity of the generation.

Paid plans include monthly credits:

* Plus: 1,500 / month
* Pro: 4,000 / month
* Ultra: 20,000 / month
* Business: 10,000 / seat / month

Unused credits roll over up to 2× the monthly amount. Example: Plus can hold up to 3,000.

Paid users can purchase additional credits.

Free plan includes 400 starter credits that do not refill. Free plan users can invite friends and earn credits when they join.

Yes! You can export any content you create as a PowerPoint (PPT) or PDF file. Alternatively, you can also import any PPT file into Gamma to be enriched.

Yes! You can save up to by choosing an annual plan compared to monthly billing.

Absolutely! You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your plan at any time from "Settings & members". If you cancel, you'll retain access to your paid features and credits until the end of your current billing period. After that, your account automatically transitions to the Free plan. You can learn more about how to manage your plan [here](https://help.gamma.app/en/articles/8568920-how-to-manage-or-cancel-your-gamma-subscription).

We accept all major credit and debit card brands. You can also pay directly via any US or EU bank. For customers in India, UPI payments are supported.

On individual paid plans (Plus, Pro, Ultra), you are charged for each additional seat when a member accepts their invitation.

On Team and Business plans, seats are purchased upfront. You can invite members up to the number of seats you’ve purchased. If you need more seats, you can buy them at any time.

Your content remains yours, regardless of your subscription status. If you downgrade or cancel, you'll retain access to all your created content, but some advanced features may be limited.

Yes, you can easily create themes inside our theme builder.

Gamma offers an API that lets you connect Gamma to other tools and workflows. It can be used directly by developers or through no-code platforms like Zapier and Make. Access is available on all plans and uses AI credits. You can get an overview [here](/products/api) and read our documentation [here](https://developers.gamma.app).

# Changelog

Latest updates and improvements to Papermark

[GitHub](https://github.com/papermark)[Twitter](https://twitter.com/papermarkio)[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/papermark-com)

[## Shipped in October 💫](/news/shipped-october-2026)

A hundred small improvements to Papermark in October, plus document signing, access requests, an inbox for every document you viewed, and data room imports from other providers.

[Read the full roundup →](/news/shipped-october-2026)

[## Access requests](/changelog/access-requests)

Visitors who are not on the allow list can request access, and you approve or deny each request.

An allow list is not always enough. With **access requests**, visitors who are not on the list can ask for access, and you approve or deny each request.

* Visitors outside the allow list request access from the link
* Approve or deny each request
* Approved visitors get in without you editing the allow list by hand

Part of [Shipped in October](/news/shipped-october-2026).

[## Document signing in data rooms](/changelog/document-signing)

Sign documents inside the data room, with no separate signing tool.

Documents can now be **signed inside the data room**. No separate signing tool, no exporting and re-uploading.

* Request a signature on a document in the data room
* See who signed and who is still pending
* Signatures are recorded in the audit log

Part of [Shipped in October](/news/shipped-october-2026).

[## Faster uploads and bulk downloads](/changelog/faster-uploads-downloads)

Uploads and bulk downloads are now faster.

Uploading documents and downloading many files at once are both **faster**, which matters most in data rooms with hundreds of files.

Part of [Shipped in October](/news/shipped-october-2026).

[## Folder search, bulk actions and quicker renaming](/changelog/folder-search-bulk-actions)

Find folders faster, act on many items at once, and rename in fewer clicks.

Large data rooms are easier to manage:

* **Folder search** to find a folder without clicking through the tree
* **Bulk actions** on many documents and folders at once
* **Quicker renaming** of documents and folders

Part of [Shipped in October](/news/shipped-october-2026).

[## Import data rooms from other providers](/changelog/import-data-rooms)

Move a data room from another provider to Papermark and bring the whole structure across.

Moving to Papermark from another data room provider? **Import the data room** and bring the whole structure across: folders, files and the index.

Part of [Shipped in October](/news/shipped-october-2026).

[## Inbox](/changelog/inbox)

Every document link you've viewed, saved in one place.

The new **Inbox** keeps every document link you've viewed in one place. Decks, teasers and data rooms that others shared with you are one click away, without digging through email.

Part of [Shipped in October](/news/shipped-october-2026).

[## Markdown and HTML support, better presentations](/changelog/markdown-html-presentations)

Share Markdown and HTML files, view presentation files better, and zoom more smoothly.

More file types look right in Papermark:

* **Markdown and HTML** support
* **Better presentation files**
* **Smoother zoom** in the viewer

Part of [Shipped in October](/news/shipped-october-2026).

[## Q&A sharing, notifications and question importing](/changelog/qa-sharing-notifications)

Share Q&A, get notified about questions, and import questions into the data room.

[Data room Q&A](/data-room-questions-and-answers) got three updates:

* **Sharing** of questions and answers
* **Notifications** for Q&A activity
* **Question importing**, so an existing question list does not have to be typed in again

Part of [Shipped in October](/news/shipped-october-2026).

[## Team management and bulk invites](/changelog/team-management-bulk-invites)

Manage your team, invite many members at once, and see your plan more clearly.

Running Papermark for a bigger team is simpler:

* **Team management** improvements
* **Bulk invites** to add many members at once
* A **clearer plan overview**

Part of [Shipped in October](/news/shipped-october-2026).

## Multiple brands, document thumbnails and richer media

Run more than one brand from a single workspace, preview documents at a glance, and share HTML and richer media formats.

* **Multiple Brands** — run more than one brand from a single workspace
* **Document thumbnails** — preview documents at a glance
* **HTML files & richer media**

## AI Redaction and Analytics Dashboard 2.0

Automatic and manual redaction with a full audit trail, a rebuilt data room analytics dashboard, and the first Groups and Permissions API.

* **AI Redaction** — automatic and manual, audited, reversible
* **PowerPoint videos & GIFs** auto-extracted and streamed
* **Data Room Analytics Dashboard 2.0** — rebuilt from scratch
* **Data Room Participants** — one view of invited vs. actually viewed vs. group access
* **Group & Permissions API v1**

## Papermark Agents — MCP server with 40+ tools

Our Product Hunt launch and the biggest single release of the period: an MCP server, API and CLI that let Claude and ChatGPT work directly with your documents and data rooms.

MCP server with 40+ tools, API and CLI. Upload documents, create tracked links, spin up rooms and pull analytics straight from Claude or ChatGPT. The biggest single launch of the period — the tool count has since grown to around 70.

## Signatures, Q&A and due diligence request lists

Sign NDAs and term sheets inside Papermark, run structured diligence request lists, and answer questions in a permissioned Q&A module.

* **Signatures** — NDAs, term sheets and SOWs signed in Papermark with a full audit trail
* **Team Collaboration** — per-data-room management access
* **Due Diligence Request List** — a structured checklist both sides can track
* **Q&A module** — permissions, threaded discussions and a full audit log

## Data Room Layouts, downloadable archive and bulk links

Customisable data room layouts, a tamper-proof downloadable archive, and bulk link creation from a CSV.

* **Data Room Layouts** — CTAs, hidden document tree, banner media
* **Downloadable Data Room Archive** — tamper-proof, OTP-protected, verifiable
* **Bulk link creation by CSV** — hundreds of links at once with per-link settings

v0.20.9

[## Multi-Folder Upload Permissions](/changelog/multi-folder-upload-permissions)

Control upload permissions for multiple folders at once

Managing visitor upload permissions just got easier with bulk folder controls.

**What's new:**

* **Select multiple folders** — apply upload permissions to several folders at once
* **Bulk permission updates** — enable or disable uploads across folder groups
* **Visitor group support** — different upload rights for different visitor groups
* **Granular control** — some folders allow uploads, others are view-only

Great for structured due diligence processes where you want buyers to upload specific documents (financial statements, contracts) to designated folders while keeping other sections read-only. Configure in your data room permissions panel.

v0.20.8

[## Download Entire Data Room as Archive](/changelog/download-data-room-archive)

Download complete data rooms as zip files with one click

Need an offline backup or local copy of your data room? You can now download the entire data room as a zip archive.

**Key features:**

* **One-click download** — get all folders and files in a single zip file
* **Preserves structure** — folder hierarchy maintained in the archive
* **Large data room support** — handles data rooms with hundreds of documents
* **Owner-only access** — available to data room owners and admins

Perfect for creating backups before major changes, archiving completed deals, or preparing offline review copies for stakeholders. Find the download option in your data room settings.

v0.20.7

[## Freeze Datarooms](/changelog/freeze-datarooms)

Close datarooms permanently and generate downloadable archives with time-limited access links

You can now freeze datarooms to close them permanently while preserving all content and activity.

**What freezing does:**

* **Blocks all visitor access** — No one can view documents or upload files
* **Prevents modifications** — Upload, reorder, and indexing are disabled
* **Triggers archive generation** — Creates a downloadable ZIP of all dataroom content
* **Provides secure download links** — Time-limited URLs for retrieving the archive

Perfect for closing completed deals, archiving old fundraising rounds, or preserving M&A transaction records.

Find the freeze option in your dataroom's **Danger Zone** settings.

v0.20.9

[## Mobile Improvements](/changelog/mobile-improvements)

Fully redesigned mobile experience with native navigation, bottom bar, and optimized sharing flows

Papermark now works beautifully on mobile devices with a complete mobile-first redesign.

**Mobile enhancements:**

* **Mobile header & bottom nav** — Native mobile navigation patterns
* **Floating share button** — Quick access to sharing from anywhere
* **Optimized dialogs & modals** — Touch-friendly controls and layouts
* **Responsive grids & cards** — Better content display on small screens
* **Streamlined share flows** — Faster link creation and pre-selection of targets

Whether you're reviewing documents, sharing links, or managing visitors — everything now works smoothly on your phone.

v0.20.7

[## Data Room Sidebar Improvements](/changelog/data-room-sidebar-improvements)

Faster navigation with improved data room sidebar design

Navigate your data rooms more efficiently with our redesigned sidebar.

**What's improved:**

* **Better folder hierarchy** — clearer visual structure for nested folders
* **Faster loading** — optimized performance for large data rooms
* **Sticky navigation** — sidebar stays visible as you scroll through documents
* **Folder icons** — easier to distinguish folders from files at a glance

Especially useful for complex data rooms with dozens of folders and hundreds of documents. The new sidebar makes it easier to jump between sections during due diligence reviews.

[Older posts→](/changelog/page/2)
